arxiv-2206-12884.title: A New Order Parameter for the Higgs Transition in 𝑺 ​ 𝑼 ​ ( 𝟐 ) SU(2) -Higgs Theory
arxiv-2206-12884.creator: Mridupawan Deka, Sanatan Digal
arxiv-2206-12884.description: Abstract We investigate the Higgs transition within the four dimensional S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) − SU(2)- gauge-Higgs model in search for an order parameter as a function of the Higgs field hopping parameter, κ \kappa , using Lattice technique.

Compact binary mergers in clusters with up to 1 million stars: mass, spin, eccentricity, merger rate and pair instability supernovae rate. 2022 The Dragon-II simulations - III. Compact binary mergers in clusters with up to 1 million stars: mass, spin, eccentricity, m
arxiv-2307-04807.creator: Manuel Arca Sedda, Albrecht W. H. Kamlah, Rainer Spurzem, Francesco Paolo Rizzuto, Mirek Giersz, Thorsten Naab, Peter Berczik
arxiv-2307-04807.description: Abstract Compact binary mergers forming in star clusters may exhibit distinctive features that can be used to identify them among observed gravitational-wave (GW) sources. Such features likely depend on the host cluster structure and the physics of massive star evolution.

arxiv-2403-04893.title: A Safe Harbor for AI Evaluation and Red Teaming
arxiv-2403-04893.creator: Shayne Longpre *, Sayash Kapoor **, Kevin Klyman **, Ashwin Ramaswami, Rishi Bommasani, Borhane Blili-Hamelin, Yangsibo Huang, Aviya Skowron, Zheng-Xin Yong, Suhas Kotha, Yi Zeng, Weiyan Shi, Xianjun Yang, Reid Southen, Alexander Robey, Patrick Chao, Diyi Yang, Ruoxi Jia, Daniel Kang, Sandy Pentland
arxiv-2403-04893.description: Abstract Independent evaluation and red teaming are critical for identifying the risks posed by generative AI systems. However, the terms of service and enforcement strategies used by prominent AI companies to deter model misuse have disincentives on good faith safety evaluations.

arxiv-2408-16219.title: Training-free Video Temporal Grounding using Large-scale Pre-trained Models
arxiv-2408-16219.creator: Minghang Zheng, Xinhao Cai, Qingchao Chen, Yuxin Peng, Yang Liu
arxiv-2408-16219.description: Abstract Video temporal grounding aims to identify video segments within untrimmed videos that are most relevant to a given natural language query. Existing video temporal localization models rely on specific datasets for training, with high data collection costs, but exhibit poor generalization capability under the across-dataset and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings.

arxiv-2511-01656.title: Constructing the big relative Fukaya category and its open–closed maps
arxiv-2511-01656.creator: Nick Sheridan
arxiv-2511-01656.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nick Sheridan. This paper continues previous work of the author with Perutz, in which the ‘small’ version of Seidel’s relative Fukaya category of a smooth complex projective variety relative to a normal crossings divisor was constructed, under a semipositivity assumption. In the present work, we generalize this to construct the ‘big’ relative Fukaya category in the same setting, as well as its closed–open and open–closed maps, and prove Abouzaid’s split-generation criterion in this context.

arxiv-2602-16145.title: Investigating GNN Convergence on Large Randomly Generated Graphs with Realistic Node Feature Correlations
arxiv-2602-16145.creator: Mohammed Zain Ali Ahmed
arxiv-2602-16145.description: Abstract There are a number of existing studies analysing the convergence behaviour of graph neural networks on large random graphs. Unfortunately, the majority of these studies do not model correlations between node features, which would naturally exist in a variety of real-life networks.

pmc-11415938.title: Infectious Thrombophlebitis of the Left Internal Jugular Vein With Tissierella praeacuta Isolation in a 71-Year-Old Female: A Case Report
pmc-11415938.creator: Shawn Howell, Morgan Gurel-Headley, Leonard Ferdman, Christian Ratzlaff
pmc-11415938.description: Tissierella praeacuta, a rare pathogen, was found in a 71-year-old female's internal jugular vein thrombus stemming from sphenoid sinusitis. She presented with lower-extremity weakness, and imaging revealed the thrombus. Subsequent intraoperative cultures identified T. praeacuta. Treatment encompassed intravenous antibiotics and anticoagulation. This case underscores the need to consider unusual pathogens in sinusitis-related thrombosis.

pmc-11430492.title: Impact of RBMS 3 Progression on Expression of EMT Markers
pmc-11430492.creator: Tomasz Górnicki, Jakub Lambrinow, Monika Mrozowska, Klaudia Krawczyńska, Natalia Staszko, Alicja Kmiecik, Aleksandra Piotrowska, Agnieszka Gomułkiewicz, Hanna Romanowicz, Beata Smolarz, Marzena Podhorska-Okołów, Jędrzej Grzegrzółka, Agnieszka Rusak, Piotr Dzięgiel
pmc-11430492.description: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) is a complex cellular process that allows cells to change their phenotype from epithelial to mesenchymal-like. Type 3 EMT occurs during cancer progression. The aim of this study was to investigate the role of RNA-binding motif single-stranded interacting protein 3 (RBMS 3) in the process of EMT.

pmc-11508665.title: Gynecologic and Obstetric Pathologies from Birth to Menopause: Unveiling the Journey and Charting the Future
pmc-11508665.creator: Panagiotis Christopoulos, Ermioni Tsarna
pmc-11508665.description: ns of menopause. As we prepare to conclude this exploration, it is timely to reflect on the recent advancements in the field, acknowledge the knowledge gaps that persist, and illuminate the exciting avenues for future research. Adolescence, the unique phase that bridges childhood and adulthood, may be accompanied by reproductive complaints and gynecologic pathologies.

pmc-12658846.title: Long-Term Disease Control With Lenvatinib in Metastatic Malignant Struma Ovarii: A Case Report
pmc-12658846.creator: Ryota Kawano, Tomoko Sumikura, Kohki Shimazu, Masahiko Takemura, Atsuhiko Uno
pmc-12658846.description: Struma ovarii is a rare monodermal teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. Although most cases are benign, some are diagnosed as malignant on the basis of histological features, local invasion, or metastatic disease. We report a patient with malignant struma ovarii who has been maintained on long-term lenvatinib (LVB) therapy for postoperative metastatic disease.

pmc-12815353.title: Prevalence and Predictors of Nomophobia among Medical Students of a University in South India
pmc-12815353.creator: S Yogeshkumar, Sasitharan Muthusamy, Rohit D. Bamane
pmc-12815353.description: Background:Nomophobia, the fear of being without mobile phone contact, is recognized as a behavioral addiction characterized by anxiety when individuals are unable to access their smartphones or mobile networks. This phenomenon is increasingly observed among medical students, whose academic and personal reliance on smartphones is significant.

pmc-13268282.title: The effects of mask applied aromatherapy on allergic rhinitis symptoms, fatigue, and quality of life related to allergic rhinitis in the COVID-19 era: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13268282.creator: Jihoo Her, Myung-Haeng Hur
pmc-13268282.description: PurposeEven after allergic rhinitis is diagnosed and treated, various symptoms such as runny nose, sneezing, and itchy nose recur periodically due to various environmental factors.MethodsThis randomized controlled trial was conducted to confirm the effectiveness of mask-based aromatherapy as a method of alleviating allergic rhinitis during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic.

pmc-13542254.title: Data-driven pipeline enables discovery of plant protein surfactants
pmc-13542254.creator: Simha Sridharan, Rammile Ettelaie, Rik Sarkar, Maryam Afzali Haji Dela, Brent S. Murray, Thomas A. Hazlehurst, Nicholas J. Watson, Anwesha Sarkar
pmc-13542254.description: Designing amphiphilic block copolymers from fossil fuel-derived hydrocarbons is a cornerstone of colloid chemistry, enabling the creation of advanced polymeric surfactants. Despite the high attractiveness of low carbon-emitting plant proteins to defossilise surfactant processing, attempts in identifying plant proteins that will function as appropriate surfactants are somewhat hit and miss.

pmc-13590129.title: Design, Synthesis, and Evaluation of New 1,4‐Naphthoquinone‐1,2,3‐triazoles as Antimalarial Agents
pmc-13590129.creator: Lina Rezainia, Mohammad Hosein Sayahi, Eisa Kaveh Vernousfaderani, Seyedeh Sara Mirfazli, Mohammad Hossein Morshedsolouk, Navid Dastyafteh, Mehdi Nateghpour, Leila Farivar, Mina Saeedi, Haleh Hanifian, Mahdi Mohebali, Seyedeh Mana Shafiee, Gholamreza Hassanpour, Mohammad Mahdavi
pmc-13590129.description: The increasing resistance to existing antimalarial agents has prompted researchers to develop new therapeutic candidates. To address this, the hybridization of 1,4‐naphthoquinone and 1,2,3‐triazole yielded a new series of compounds evaluated as prospective in vitro antimalarial agents against the chloroquine‐sensitive 3D7 and chloroquine‐resistant K1 strains of Plasmodium falciparum.

pmc-13630962.title: A Prospective, Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT) of the da Vinci SP® Surgical System versus Open Surgery in Nipple-Sparing Mastectomy (NSM) Procedures for Patients with Breast Cancer
pmc-13630962.creator: Katherine Kopkash, Mara Piltin, James Jakub, Sara Javid, Meghan R Flanagan, Rebecca Aft, Akiko Chiba, Alysandra Lal, Ari D Brooks, Farin Amersi, Nayana Dekhne, Jennifer Tseng, Clara Farley, Alan Kadison, Jeffrey Johnson, Rosa F Hwang
pmc-13630962.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThis prospective randomized trial evaluated the safety and effectiveness of robotic-assisted nipple-sparing mastectomy (rNSM) using the da Vinci Single Port (SP)® compared with open NSM in women with early stage breast cancer.Patients and MethodsThis Food and Drug Administration (FDA) investigational device exemption (IDE)-approved, two-arm, multicenter randomized controlled trial (RCT) randomized eligible women (clinical Tis-T2, N0) 1:1 to rNSM or open NSM with immediate implant-based reconstruction. Operations were performed at 14 US sites by 23 surgeons.

(commonly known as the “Second Morrill Act”).
